todo_line: - [ ] 006 Add and focused-test the signed-in read-only targeted-add route with same-club person/group resolution, current display authority, sign-in return, protected-detail denial, heading focus, selected-person and already-member states, and scanner-safe GET behaviour that performs no membership mutation.
outcome: The existing read-only targeted-add panel uses the group facts returned by `Membership.resolve_custom_group_target_authoritatively/3` for its heading, already-member status, and consequence copy, while retaining the ordinary projection-backed display gate and every accepted scanner-safe route behavior.
scope: Retain the existing task-006 candidate route, sign-in return, ordinary projection-backed member-management display gate, same-club authoritative target resolution, Members-page placement, focus markup, selected-person and already-member states, privacy handling, and mutation-free GET behavior.

In `MemberDashboardLive.present_targeted_group_member/1`, preserve the `group.name` returned by `Membership.resolve_custom_group_target_authoritatively/3` in the targeted presentation data alongside the existing person, membership, initials, and current-participation facts.

In the targeted panel call in `club.html.heex`, supply the resolver-owned group name from `@targeted_group_member`, not `@selected_group.name`. Ensure the panel heading, already-member status, and consequence copy all continue to receive that one resolver-owned value.

Add a focused behavioral regression that makes the projected selected-group name differ from the Club aggregate/resolver group name, opens the targeted route, and proves the targeted heading and relevant status or consequence copy use the resolver-owned name. Keep this setup test-only; do not add group-renaming behavior.
scope_exclusions: Do not add an aggregate-backed actor authorization query or require immediate targeted-GET denial after a committed role revocation or club departure while display projections lag. The approved plan now explicitly accepts that read-only preview trade-off.

Do not weaken or bypass the existing projection-backed display gate for forged, cross-club, built-in, inactive-target, or never-authorised access. Do not expose protected person, membership, member-list, conversation, or compose details on generic denials.

Do not dispatch `Membership.add_custom_group_member/2`, add the target, send a welcome, or add a functioning targeted Add event. Authoritative actor and target rechecks at confirmation, stale-preview denial at Add, mutation, idempotence, and welcome behavior remain task 007.
Do not implement targeted Cancel/Escape handling, return focus, success announcements, or post-add member-row focus; those transitions remain task 007.

Do not change the accepted authoritative resolver contract, route shape, ordinary dashboard display policy, request-access messaging/UI, email rendering, general custom-group picker/removal behavior, acceptance feature files, or the iteration-066 browser journey.

Do not edit the approved plan, ADRs, iteration acceptance criteria, or project reference docs. Do not run `dev check`, `dev check --quick`, `dev ci`, or another unscoped full-suite command in this revision.

references.facts: The approved clarification keeps the ordinary projection-backed display gate, accepts brief read-only preview lag, forbids adding an aggregate-backed GET check solely for immediate revocation, and leaves the resolver-owned group-facts discrepancy as the task-006 recovery gap.

`assign_targeted_group_member/1` already gates on the ordinary `can_add_custom_group_members?` presentation value and calls the accepted resolver. `present_targeted_group_member/1` currently discards `target.group`; carry its name into the targeted presentation without changing authorization or dispatching a command.

The targeted panel currently receives projected `@selected_group.name`. Change only this call to use the group name carried in `@targeted_group_member`; other ordinary dashboard copy may continue using `@selected_group.name`.

The stateless panel already uses its required `group_name` attribute consistently in the heading, already-member status, and consequence copy. Preserve its stable IDs, focus behavior, and current no-Add-control state.

The accepted resolver returns a plain `group` summary from Club aggregate state, including `name`, after typed same-club custom-group validation. Reuse that existing output; do not add another public query or expose aggregate state.

This remains the approved projection-backed display gate for the read-only preview. Its selected-group name may lag or differ, which is why it must not provide the targeted panel's resolver-owned group copy.

The existing focused tests cover sign-in return, participant/outside-admin display, ordinary denial, invalid and cross-club targets, already-member state, heading focus, conversation privacy, and inert GET/mount. Add one discriminating resolver-name regression and keep all existing cases passing.
The approved targeted scene uses one consistent group name in `Add to Board`, consequence copy, and already-member state while GET remains a preview.
The existing route and `handle_params/3` implementation correctly model the targeted person as refreshable visible state; preserve that accepted shape.

Club owns authoritative membership and role write decisions. For this revised task, those facts must be rechecked at the later Add boundary rather than introducing a new aggregate-backed read solely for GET.
Keep the existing LiveView route-driven state and selector-based focused tests using stable element IDs.

constraints: Use `92cda0d9334eb1a8b4c2fdf3fdf95d89264df7c3` as the revision baseline, preserve task identity 006, and retain candidate origin `006-8d42dd1-1`; this is the same rejected obligation, not a new implementation attempt.
Treat the current approved plan as authoritative over the earlier review rationale: do not implement the now-superseded aggregate-backed GET actor check or stale-projection GET-denial tests.

The host-selected club and route-selected group remain inputs to the accepted target resolver. The targeted panel's group label must come only from the resolver-returned group summary, never from projected `selected_group`, route text, email content, referer, or client input.
Keep both disconnected GET and connected mount read-only: no membership command, group event, welcome, request status, follow change, or conversation-access change.

Keep production changes minimal and localized to carrying the existing resolver-owned group fact into presentation and rendering it. A test-only projection mismatch may establish the regression without adding product-level group rename support.
Preserve the existing generic denial behavior and all task-006 route, privacy, focus, already-member, and no-mutation coverage.
completion_evidence_required: Return every changed path and identify where the resolver-returned `group.name` is retained and where the targeted panel consumes it.

Show the focused regression in which projected selected-group copy differs from the authoritative resolver group name, and show that the targeted heading plus already-member status or consequence copy render the resolver-owned value.
Confirm the ordinary projection-backed display gate is unchanged and no aggregate-backed GET actor query or stale-projection GET-denial requirement was added.
Confirm every pre-existing task-006 focused case still passes and disconnected GET/connected mount remain free of group-add events and welcome email.
Confirm no targeted admission event, Add handling, welcome dispatch, Cancel/Escape behavior, success transition, acceptance-feature change, or browser-journey enablement was included.
Record the focused validation command, working directory, exit status, and test/failure counts; list any unresolved issue.
